description: Reads a site's public crossdomain.xml (Adobe Flash) and clientaccesspolicy.xml (Silverlight) if they exist, lists the origins they allow, and flags wildcard grants ('*'). Old policies are rarely needed now, so a wildcard here mostly means leftovers; absence is the normal case. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_crossdomain_xml_test
title: Reads a site's public crossdomain.xml
